summary: Implemented DatabricksOauthProfileMapping (cosmos/profiles/databricks/oauth.py), exported it from cosmos/profiles/databricks/__init__.py and cosmos/profiles/__init__.py, registered it ahead of DatabricksTokenProfileMapping in profile_mappings, and added tests/profiles/databricks/test_dbr_oauth.py. The mapping emits auth_type: oauth, takes client_id from login (or extra.client_id) and client_secret from password (or extra.client_secret), and stores the secret in the env var COSMOS_CONN_DATABRICKS_CLIENT_SECRET. Tests were not run, per instructions. Nothing was committed. Documentation and changelog were not updated. Known edge case: a connection with both a login and a password token would be claimed as OAuth.
